disposition_reason: The source reports ordered human motion-trace agreement, but the registered Pt01-Pt03 task is currently scored by a new consistency/fidelity panel rather than an exactly recovered paper endpoint. Published per-patient correlations are recoverable; their exact temporal alignment, preprocessing, corresponding author output and an admissible full-cohort comparison remain unresolved. Human agreement must not be relabelled absolute motion accuracy.

source_paper.title: DREDge: robust motion correction for high-density extracellular recordings across species

evidence.locator: Results: DREDge rescues spike sorting and LFP features in human brain activity; Extended Data Fig. 2; Methods: Preprocessing of LFP band data
evidence.supports: Human manual-tracking agreement and LFP preprocessing; recovered source correlations are Pt01 0.98, Pt02 0.99, Pt03 0.85.
Original AP and LFP motion estimation implementation, rigid/nonrigid modes and registration demos.

evidence.locator: Version 224794 pages 1 and 2; file inventory only
evidence.supports: Versioned raw Pt01-Pt03 AP/LFP inputs, metadata, motion tracking CSVs and already-aligned derivatives are distinct assets.

evidence.locator: Implemented computation; Prospective metrics and scientific limits; Source audit
evidence.supports: Local rigid control, linear interpolation and held-channel consistency/fidelity metrics are prospective and not native paper accuracy/reproduction.

target.description: Estimate brain/probe displacement and stabilize the human recordings; the recovered ordered source comparison is agreement of DREDge LFP motion with manual LFP tracking, not independently observed physical displacement.

dataset.description: Human Neuropixels deposit Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.d2547d840, version 224794: raw AP/LFP data and metadata. Already-aligned data must not replace raw candidate inputs.

cohort.description: All three source manual-tracking participants Pt01, Pt02 and Pt03; acute mouse, Ultra, chronic or synthetic cohorts are different original paper experiments and cannot substitute for this human registration.

split.description: This source human agreement analysis is not a supervised train/test benchmark. Exact recording intervals, dropped samples, temporal matching and any tuning exposure behind the reported correlations are not yet bound. A newly reserved channel/time split is an extension.

inputs.description: Raw human LFP with channel geometry and acquisition metadata for motion inference; AP can assess resulting stability. Manual tracks are evaluation references only. Availability of DepthMicronsTracking CSV names does not establish their exact correspondence to the published manual reference.

preprocessing.description: Source describes IBL LFP preprocessing, downsampling and spatial sharpening; exact patient-specific settings, edge support and author trace resampling for the correlation endpoint have not been recovered. The local raw-grid linear interpolation differs from native preprocessing/kriging.

metric.description: Published human comparison uses Pearson correlation between DREDge and manual LFP displacement traces per patient. Correlation increases agreement but is insensitive to offset/scale and does not certify physical displacement accuracy. Exact reference/temporal alignment is unresolved; adjacent-time voltage consistency is a different metric.

aggregation.description: Source reports separate Pearson r values for three patients, not a single cohort threshold. Preserve the full patient vector; do not silently average or select Pt03 to manufacture a scalar paper baseline.

comparison.primary_metric: Original per-patient Pearson correlation with manual LFP motion trace; exact full-cohort admission rule unresolved

published_baseline.description: Source vector recovered: Pt01 r=0.98, Pt02 r=0.99, Pt03 r=0.85. No scalar source aggregate is supplied and the exact trace alignment is not bound; null avoids inventing an average or choosing a patient.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authenticated native full-cohort DREDge output or same-endpoint rerun is established. The independent local rigid control and consistency panel are not the author baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful increase in manual-trace agreement requires a defined original vector comparison and checks that neural fidelity is retained; near-ceiling correlations do not justify an arbitrary universal margin.

uncertainty.method: Recover original paired traces, then predeclare a patient-preserving analysis that accounts for temporal autocorrelation and the small cohort; do not use raw sample count as independent replication.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant/recording for cross-person claims; autocorrelation-aware time blocks only for conditional within-recording uncertainty.
uncertainty.rationale: Three patients and temporally dense LFP samples cannot yield an inflated independent sample count. A stronger p-value is not a motion improvement.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact source raw segments, manual references, temporal alignment, preprocessing and native author outputs for Pt01-Pt03.
Predeclare an ordered full-cohort rule against the recovered source per-patient results without selecting one patient or silently constructing a new reported aggregate.
Compare frozen candidate and competent author execution on identical original inputs and source metric, with justified effect and dependence-aware uncertainty.
Retain neural fidelity and report the claim as improvement of source manual-trace agreement; no claim of absolute physical displacement truth follows.
Do not count local adjacent-time consistency, oversmoothing, new held-channel/time subsets or synthetic-motion accuracy as surpassing the original human task.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA claim is made; source comparisons on other species/recording types do not establish human-task SOTA.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive until source endpoint recovery. Any later iteration must use separately declared development evidence while preserving the source human comparison and recording membership.
episode.candidate_freeze: Before source final evaluation, freeze code, registration parameters, preprocessing, input-support policy, displacement outputs and the original alignment/metric evaluator.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay both methods on every original Pt01-Pt03 source interval using the recovered manual reference; no new channel/time split can substitute. Operator-held reference traces remain unavailable to candidate fitting.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep source per-patient correlations, a future native author rerun and any prospective consistency diagnostics distinct. No native replay was performed in this curation. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Exact original human temporal support, manual-reference identity and trace alignment need source-level recovery.
Patient-specific preprocessing and complete native registration/interpolation route are not executed or authenticated.
No source scalar aggregate or predeclared scientifically valid full-cohort superiority rule is established.
Current local evaluator measures a different prospective consistency/fidelity endpoint.
Meaningful effect, temporal-dependence-aware uncertainty, fixed episode budgets and working source endpoint remain unresolved.

legacy.notes: Preserve loader, rigid comparator and consistency/fidelity diagnostics. Their engineering correctness or improved internal alignment cannot establish surpassing the published human motion result.
